# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the versioned SocialGoal report. Use the links below to navigate to the detailed architecture, dependency, configuration, data, API, and workflow analyses.

- [architecture-diagram](architecture-diagram.md): High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map](dependency-map.md): Declared package dependencies grouped by functional area.
- [api-service-contracts](api-service-contracts.md): Controller surface, contracts, and request communication patterns.
- [data-architecture](data-architecture.md): Database configuration, entity relationships, and repository layer summary.
- [configuration-inventory](configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, properties, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows](business-workflows.md): Core user workflows, service-to-domain mapping, and decision logic.
